puntos.titulo: Your website does not take bookings

Portals provide visibility, but they should not be the only channel. Direct booking improves the margin and the relationship with the guest.
Spreadsheets and scattered notes make it difficult to know what is free, what has been paid and what changes during the day.

precios.ctaTexto: Tell us your number of units, how you manage bookings today and what material is ready. We will return a fixed scope.

alta.titulo: Guided implementation, with a clear scope
alta.texto: We collect your accommodation, rates, content and brand materials; configure the environment and review the complete flow with you before launch. Timing is agreed according to scope and the state of the source data.

items.q: What exactly is included in the €49 Start plan?
items.a: A responsive website with your brand, hosting, HTTPS, basic SEO, one language and a form that sends each enquiry to reception's email. It does not include the manager, booking engine or enquiry history; it is the first step and requires a 12-month commitment.

items.q: Do I have to change my domain?
items.a: No. Your site lives on your own domain, with your brand. We put the engine underneath.

items.q: What if I already use Booking?
items.a: You can keep it. Direct booking from your site saves you the commission on every reservation that comes in on your own; many campsites use both.

items.q: Is it hard for my receptionist?
items.a: It is designed around everyday reception tasks: reviewing arrivals, finding a booking, taking payment, reassigning a unit and recording departure. The implementation includes guidance for the team.
Each campsite has its own isolated database on Cloudflare's network. No other client can see your bookings.

items.q: How soon do I have it?
items.a: It depends on the level and on having the material ready. Before starting we agree the scope, content and launch date; Start has a contained onboarding process, while Management requires inventory, rates and operations to be configured.

privacy.description: How Logic2B processes data submitted through the Camp commercial landing page.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy applies to commercial enquiries on camp.logic2b.com, not to fictional demo data or future customer deployments.

sections.title: Data, purpose and lawful basis
paragraphs: We collect the details you provide in the form —name, campsite, email, optional phone, plan and optional message— to answer your enquiry, prepare a demo or assess a project.
items: Consent given when submitting the form.
Pre-contractual steps requested by the interested person.

sections.title: Providers
paragraphs: We only share data with providers required to operate the site and deliver the enquiry, under their respective contracts and safeguards.
items: Cloudflare: hosting, security and delivery of the site.
Resend: transport of the enquiry email to Logic2B's inbox.
Google: analytics for the commercial site, only if you accept cookies.

sections.title: Retention and recipients
paragraphs: We retain the enquiry for as long as needed to respond and, if a commercial relationship starts, for the applicable periods. We do not sell the data or use it for third-party advertising.

sections.title: International transfers
paragraphs: Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where this occurs, safeguards under the GDPR are used, such as adequacy decisions or standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, erasure, objection, restriction or portability by writing to the email above. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency.

cookies.heading: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: Analytics is limited to the Logic2B Campings commercial site. The campsite demos and manager do not include this measurement container.

sections.title: What we use
paragraphs: Essential local storage remembers your choice. Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics only load if you accept the analytics category; if you reject it, no Google resource is requested.
items: Essential: the versioned l2b-consent choice in local storage.
Analytics: Google Analytics cookies measuring aggregate use and commercial conversions without sending form data.

sections.title: What we do not use
paragraphs: Camp does not activate advertising cookies, remarketing, Google Ads or social pixels. Analytics events never include a name, email, phone, message or booking data.

sections.title: How to withdraw consent
paragraphs: You can change your choice at any time with the button on this page. Withdrawing analytics removes Google cookies accessible to the browser and prevents new emissions.
